events.description: Book Tickets - Thurs Oct 1 #block-yui_3_17_2_1_1786744260461_2750 { --sqs-block-content-flex: 0; } #block-yui_3_17_2_1_1786744260461_2750 { --opacity: 100%; --translate-x: 0px; --translate-y: 0px; --rotation: 0deg; --scale-x: 100%; --scale-y: 100%; --skew-x: 0deg; --skew-y: 0deg; --origin-x: 50%; --origin-y: 50%; --block-transform: none; opacity: var(--opacity, 1); transform: var(--block-transform); transform-origin: var(--origin-x) var(--origin-y); } Come join us for another MINTimate Poetry evening in the gallery at Mint Art House, followed by spoken words by our October feature poet Dean Barker. Dean built a time machine intending to travel to the future and plagiarise all the good poetry before it was written. Unfortunately by then, A.I. was so prolific that almost every peom began with "There once was a man from Nantucket". This left him no option but to write about the humour, absurdity, and pain of life, explored through themes of loneliness, neurodiversity, and equality. He also has an unhealthy passionfruit addiction.
